title: brain check reports backend contract mistakes before start
why: A missing route secret, an invalid route contract, bad analytics settings or a missing handler or hook now appear in `brain check` instead of failing at `brain backend serve`, and a non-numeric analytics setting is refused rather than ignored.
changelog: report an invalid route contract as B0735
steps: Run `brain check` and fix each B0735 and B0790 it reports: set the secret, correct the contract, or create the missing handler or hook file.
